# LFSB - Bâle-Mulhouse
> **Reminder:** This document is intended for use by air traffic controllers on the VATSIM network only and is exclusively for flight simulation purposes. It shall not be used for real-world air traffic control operations.
{.is-warning}

EuroAirport Basel-Mulhouse-Freiburg (LFSB) is an international airport located approximately 6 kilometres northwest of Basel, close to the French-Swiss border and the city of Saint-Louis in the Haut-Rhin department. It primarily serves the tri-national region of Basel, Mulhouse and Freiburg.

The airport has a main terminal dedicated to commercial aviation, as well as facilities for general and business aviation. It has two runways: runway 07/25, mainly used for general aviation operations, and runway 15/33, which serves as the primary runway for commercial aviation.

**The transition altitude is 7,000 ft**, and both IFR and VFR flights are permitted.

> **Important:** This airport is controlled by the French vACC and Swiss vACC as per the published Letter of Agreement. The information contained in this document is shared between controllers to ensure consistent procedures and operations across the network.
{.is-warning}
